content.caseIdentity: Donoghue v. Stevenson, [1932] AC 562 (House of Lords)
content.holding: A manufacturer of products sold in such a form as to show that they intend them to reach the ultimate consumer without intermediate examination owes a legal duty of care to the consumer. Formulated the foundational "Neighbour Principle".
content.relevance: Established negligence as an independent tort and demolished the privity of contract fallacy in product liability.
